items.title: Saudi Arabia issues warning of potential danger in Yanbu oil hub
items.summary:
Saudi Arabia’s civil defence issued an alert on Thursday warning of potential danger in Yanbu Governorate.
Yanbu, on Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea coast, is a major oil export hub and a key outlet for crude shipments transported through the kingdom’s East-West pipeline.

items.title: Punjab local govt elections to begin on Feb 7 next year: ECP
items.summary:
The Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP) has scheduled the first phase of local government elections in Punjab for February 7, 2027.

items.title: Iran's IRGC says two tankers and tugboat caught fire in Strait of Hormuz
items.summary:
Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said on Thursday that two oil tankers and a tugboat had caught fire in separate incidents after attempting to use unauthorised routes through the Strait of Hormuz.
One tanker struck a mine while attempting to cross a passage south of the strait, while another supertanker caught fire while exiting the route in the eastern part of the waterway, the IRGC said.
